title: Hypothesis failure for Ioana's Theorem 8.2 under a twisted comultiplication (v0.1.3-report)
description: Prepared version v0.1.3-report, 28 October 2026; unreleased, publication gate pending. Corrects the summary of Ioana Theorem 8.2 and responds to Section 21 of the 49-page Nielsen NIEWTC artifact and its retained Section 9 appeal. The bounded result remains failure of hypothesis (2) for the specified twisted comultiplication. No nonexistence of morphisms or impossibility of all other routes is asserted. The Lean companion imports the concrete image situation classically and proves the semantic containment-to-intertwining consequence; no full operator-algebra formalization is claimed. Completed reviews and remaining fresh-kernel and final artifact delta checks are recorded in the repository verification record. ArXiv submission and outreach require separate human approval. No new version DOI exists. Historical science v0.1.2 DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21859653; science concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21845586. Companion Lean v0.1.1-obstruction DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21859309.
